I will keep this plot mostly the way I have managed similar land before, because 6.37 hectares is big and cash can disappear fast if I start buying many inputs at once. Since this is my own land and I intercrop, I will put manure where I can, use the seed I already trust, and rely on the rains because I do not have irrigation here in Tabora. For weed control and the heavy work on a plot this size, I will hire some people, and I will also use herbicide so I do not lose too much time with the hand hoe.
